tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Find listed public agents by task, capability, category, framework, model, verified evidence, or reuse configuration. Owner telemetry and controlled benchmark evidence are returned separately.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Get one public agent's recipe, public capability manifest, coarse invocation status, owner telemetry, and verified benchmark submissions.

tools.name: list_benchmarks
tools.description: List public, versioned benchmark contracts and only their trusted-runner-verified submissions.
